description.zh-CN: 把 Komari 节点变成 3D 小鸡，并支持访客在线互啄的 companion 主题。
description.en: A Komari companion theme that turns nodes into 3D chickens and supports multiplayer pecking.

name.zh-CN: 伴生服务 WebSocket 地址

help.zh-CN: 例如 wss://chicken.example.com/ws。这里只能填写公开地址，切勿填写任何 Token；伴生服务的探针凭据必须保存在服务端。
help.en: For example wss://chicken.example.com/ws. Put only a public URL here, never a token. Keep probe credentials on the companion service.

help.zh-CN: 最多 12 个字符；访客仍可在页面中修改。
help.en: Up to 12 characters. Visitors can still change it on the page.

help.zh-CN: 完整显示 CPU、内存、流量和在线时长；精简只显示状态；关闭隐藏名牌。
help.en: Full shows CPU, memory, traffic and uptime; compact shows status only; hidden disables nameplates.
